evidence_boundary: A no-candidate result states only that no observable generalized Lie/value mode in the complete combined-degree-three-or-less state/energy/symmetric-mass library passed every frozen development, calibration, exact S1, family-fold-subspace, and trajectory gate after exact coefficient-space removal of the represented Xi constraint ideal and angular-momentum parameter module. This is a locked remediation rerun on previously examined development/calibration data, not fresh confirmatory evidence, a proof that no first integral exists, or a non-integrability theorem.

staged_policy.SEARCH_READY: Requires both prerequisite locks and records, exact hashes for every consumed spatial corpus/result, an intact pre-search lock and reserve commitment, rank-30 exact known-module removal, and passing Xi/angular control diagnostics.
staged_policy.CANDIDATE_READY: Requires every frozen train/calibration/family/gauge threshold. No interpretation is authorized.
staged_policy.SEALED_QUALIFICATION: Can be triggered only by CANDIDATE_READY=PASS under a new candidate-specific lock.
staged_policy.WP4_READY: Can be triggered only by a passing candidate-specific sealed qualification and independent replication.
